entity: Louisiana's five-year re-inspection rate for large-quantity hazardous-waste generators, and its rank among states
why: The EPA OIG table (Apr 2026, same entity, same LQG inspection measure, overlapping window) shows Louisiana at 59% with Texas 55, Illinois 48, New Hampshire 58 and Connecticut 36 below it, the opposite of our 'last of 28 states, next lowest Illinois 62.7, Texas 66.5'; Illinois 48 vs our 62.7 is also >25% off. The low-rate claim itself roughly matched (59 vs 49.5, within 25%), but one contradicted claim decides the bin.
